newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end up 1.56 pct on retail speculation.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end up 1.56 pct on retail speculation.

text.p: Thai stocks rallied strongly on Friday as retail speculators bet on successful talks among partners of coalition leader Chavalit Yongchaiyudh in sharing cabinet portfolios, analysts said.
The SET Index closed advancing 14.95 points, or 1.56 percent, to 970.30 on moderate five billion baht turnover. The SET-50 finished 1.43 points up at 74.60.
"I think retail buying was boosted by expectations that the market would rebound," said Kanjanee Kangwanpornsiri, assistant Managing Director at Thai Fuji.
